strings.app.name: ToneSphere
strings.transport.exclusive_tooltip:
Bypass the OS mixer for the lowest latency.
Measured here: 8.3 ms exclusive against 22 ms shared on the same device.
No other application can use the device while ToneSphere holds it.
strings.transport.buffer_tooltip:
Frames per callback. Smaller is lower latency with less margin before a
dropout — watch the XRUNS counter after lowering it.
strings.transport.monitor_tooltip: Hear an input — your guitar, a microphone — on an output, right now
strings.patchbay.title: Patchbay
strings.patchbay.hint: drag a right-hand port onto a left-hand port to patch  ·  right-click a cable for options  ·  middle-drag to pan
strings.mixer.title: Mixer
strings.mixer.add_bus_tooltip: Create an in-process mix bus (not visible to other apps)

strings.menu.language.unreviewed: Machine-translated · not reviewed by a native speaker
strings.dialog.language_not_saved: The language has been changed for this session, but it could not be saved: {reason}
strings.about.title: About ToneSphere
strings.about.asio_note:
ASIO: no ASIO driver is installed on this computer. Everything works on Windows audio (WASAPI);
WASAPI exclusive is the low-latency path. An installed ASIO driver appears as an extra backend.
strings.about.bus_note:
Mix buses are in-process only and cannot be selected from other
applications. The ToneSphere virtual cable driver that would allow it is built but
not yet verified or production-signed — see docs/VIRTUAL_AUDIO_DRIVER.md.
strings.about.translation_note: This interface is shown in {language}. The translation was machine-made and has not been reviewed by a native speaker.
strings.master.title: MASTER
strings.master.limiter_tooltip: Gain reduction protecting the converter from a summing over
strings.meter.tooltip: Click to clear the clip indicator
strings.fader.tooltip: Drag to set gain · Shift for fine · double-click for unity
strings.pan.tooltip: Drag to pan · Shift for fine · double-click to centre
strings.transport.rate_tooltip: Sample rate. Changing it restarts the engine; every device is opened at this rate.
strings.transport.diagnostics_tooltip: Callback timing, load, latency broken down, and a real round-trip measurement (Ctrl+D)

strings.strip.inserts_unavailable: Plugins need the native engine (Windows) and a hardware device
strings.plugins.status.not_a_plugin: no audio effects in this module
strings.plugins.instrument_detail: An instrument plays notes: add it with Plugins > Add Instrument, which gives it a bus of its own, and play it from its keyboard, a REST call or the CLI.
strings.plugins.browser.title: VST3 Plugins
strings.plugins.browser.scanning: Scanning — each module is opened in a separate process, so a broken one cannot take ToneSphere down…
strings.plugins.browser.found: {usable} usable here in {modules} module(s). Modules that failed are listed with the reason (hover for detail).

strings.plugins.inserts.hint: Processed top to bottom, after trim and before the fader. Values shown are read back from the effect after each change: a plugin's are its own display text.
strings.plugins.inserts.bypass_tooltip: The host's bypass: the plugin is not called at all, and its latency stops counting
strings.plugins.effect_detail: An effect: add it to a chain from a strip's Inserts.
strings.keyboard.title: Keyboard — {name}
strings.keyboard.hint: Click the keys, or play A W S E D F T G Y H U J K on your computer keyboard; Z and X shift the octave.

strings.diag.title: Diagnostics
strings.diag.allocations: Heap allocations on the audio thread
strings.diag.measured: Measured round trip, this rate and block
strings.diag.measure_loopback: The output's own loopback (digital path only)
strings.diag.measure_warning: Stop the engine first. A half-second sweep plays at -24 dBFS. It needs a loopback cable from output to input, or a microphone that can hear the speaker; without one the result is --.
strings.diag.measure_unsupported: Round-trip measurement needs the native engine on WASAPI.
strings.diag.virtual_windows_only: Windows only; see docs/VIRTUAL_AUDIO_DRIVER.md for this platform
strings.diag.virtual_note: The ToneSphere virtual cables Windows lists, and their state (manage them from Engine > Virtual Cables). The driver is verified in a test VM and is test-signed: production signing is not available. See docs/VIRTUAL_AUDIO_DRIVER.md.
strings.cables.title: Virtual Cables
strings.cables.hint: Each cable is a device Windows lists: programs play into its output and record from its input. Changing one changes the machine's devices, so Windows asks for an administrator each time.
strings.cables.column.name: Cable
strings.cables.name_prompt: Name, as programs will list it:
strings.cables.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall "{name}"? Programs using it lose it.
strings.cables.remove_driver_confirm: Remove every ToneSphere cable and the driver itself?
strings.cables.none: No cables: the ToneSphere driver is not installed, or every cable was uninstalled.
strings.cables.windows_only: Virtual cables are a Windows driver; see docs/VIRTUAL_AUDIO_DRIVER.md for this platform.
strings.crash.title: ToneSphere ran into a problem
strings.monitor.title: Monitor Input
strings.monitor.hint: Choose what to hear and where. It starts as soon as you press Start: no muted cable, no extra step.
strings.monitor.feedback: These are the computer's own microphone and speakers: they can howl with feedback. Use headphones, or keep the volume low.
strings.backend.asio_unavailable_tooltip:
Nothing needs ASIO: every feature works on Windows audio, and WASAPI exclusive gives low latency.
Install your interface's ASIO driver, or ASIO4ALL, and ASIO appears here.
strings.patchbay.drop_missed: Let go of the cable on a device or bus to connect it.
strings.patchbay.drop_not_input: "{name}" is an input: it sends audio, nothing can be patched into it.
strings.cables.no_driver: Virtual cables need the ToneSphere audio driver, which is not installed. It cannot be installed on a normal Windows computer yet: Windows only loads drivers Microsoft has signed, and this one is not signed. Everything else in ToneSphere works without it.
